author: agent
text: Being canonical is not the same as being the only copy. This was promoted to THE rule in 0.53.1, and the structural test guarding it scanned two modules - the two being edited at the time. FOUR copies of the crude `"test" in path.lower()` heuristic survived that guard, in indexer.py, harvest.py (twice) and metrics.py, for two more releases. The crude form disagrees with this function on contest.py, src/test_helpers/, latest.py and protest/ (false positives) and on foo_test.go, foo.spec.ts, FooTest.java (false negatives). A guard scoped to where the author happened to be looking is not a guard: test_only_one_test_rule_exists now AST-walks every module in the package and names what it scanned, so a new module cannot pass by being absent from a hand-written list. Fixed 0.53.3, 2026-08-16.
